notes: SLOT 11 (01:05 IST fire / 2026-09-21 19:36 UTC) - WORK SLOT. Item 13 (zero-fake-success sweep) extended to the Android Bridge app-launch path. AndroidBridgeManager.openApplication() in src/utils/androidBridgeEngine.ts recorded an APP_OPENED audit event with result UNSUPPORTED but ran no gates at all, and SimulatedAndroidAdapter.openApp() in src/utils/androidBridgeAdapter.ts returned a hardcoded success:true reading '[SIMULATION_ONLY] Launch intent triggered'; App.tsx handleOpenMobileApp discarded the return value. A launch could be presented as done on a disconnected bridge, under the Global Kill Switch, or on a device not reporting launch capability. Fix: openApplication() now checks four real gates in order (bridge connected + capability handshake, emergency stop, device canOpenApp, app privacy rule), returns success:false with a blockedReason on every path, and audits each refusal with the matching result (privacy-denied now records ACTION_DENIED instead of APP_OPENED). The simulated adapter delegates to the engine; App.tsx speaks the real message. Guard: src/tests/androidMobileBridge.test.ts Scenarios 17-18 (37 tests in file) - observed 37/37 passing. Negative-validated: replacing the connection gate with if(false) fails Scenario 17 with TypeError Cannot read properties of null (reading 'canOpenApp') (observed 1 failed | 36 skipped); restored, re-observed 37/37. Observed gates: npm run lint (tsc --noEmit) exit 0; npx vitest run 64 files / 924 tests passed; npm run build exit 0 (dist/server.cjs 825.6 kb). Commits ffc5949 (fix), 9a68892 (docs) pushed to origin/feature/hermes-full-completion. Item 13 stays PARTIAL - pattern-driven sweep, not proof no unmeasured claim survives. Next slot: continue item 13 into the communication path or the Autonomous Tools HUD, then communication items 30-34.
